headline: Prosecutors Claim Yella Beezy Used Kewon White as Crash Dummy in 'K-ll Mo 3' Incident
body: DJ Akademiks' Instagram post reports prosecutors allege Yella Beezy used Kewon White as a crash dummy in the 'K-ll Mo 3' incident. The post, published September 4, 2026, states the claim with 2,188 likes and 330 comments. No details on the alleged crash or legal proceedings were provided in the post. The claim appears to be a legal accusation without context of the alleged crime or evidence.
